description: Use when practitioners need to understand system-managed fields (CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate, SystemModstamp, CreatedById, LastModifiedById, IsDeleted) — their update behavior, indexing, and queryability. Triggers: 'difference between SystemModstamp and LastModifiedDate', 'how to query deleted records', 'set CreatedDate during data migration', 'why does LastModifiedDate not match SystemModstamp', 'Create Audit Fields permission'. NOT for a field's value-change history — use data/field-history-tracking. NOT for Shield Field Audit Trail — use security/field-audit-trail.
inputs: Which system fields are being referenced or queried
Whether the use case is delta sync, data migration, audit reporting, or soft-delete recovery
Org edition and whether Create Audit Fields permission is enabled
name: system-field-behavior-and-audit
official_sources: Object Reference: System Fields — supports the LastModifiedDate vs SystemModstamp definitions, the "doesn't capture every field change" caveat and the Create Audit Fields steps and object list: object_reference 264 L2563, L2566, L2581-2583, L2592-2603, L3125, L3132-3133 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/system_fields.htm

Help: Set Audit Fields upon Record Creation — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.enable_set_audit_fields.htm — help.salesforce.com is not in the corpus; the Setup steps are grounded instead in object_reference 264 L2599-2603 (UNVERIFIED (2026-10-20) for anything only this article says).

REST API Developer Guide: queryAll — supports the `/queryAll` URI: api_rest 264 L17247; Bulk API queryAll operation and archived Task/Event records: api_asynch 264 L6670-6671 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/dome_queryall.htm

Apex Developer Guide: ALL ROWS and undelete — supports ALL ROWS covering deleted records and archived activities, no FOR UPDATE, and the 15-day Recycle Bin: apex dev guide 264 L8358, L8446, L10124-10130 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_dml_undelete.htm

Large Data Volumes Best Practices — supports the default index list (SystemModstamp, CreatedDate, Name, Id) and Recycle Bin soft-deletion behaviour: salesforce_large_data_volumes_bp 264 L309, L404-411, L738-742.
Metadata API: FieldHistoryArchive `archiveAfterMonths` (18-month default) — supports the 18-month note in Related Skills: api_meta 264 L46331-46332.
outputs: Field selection guidance for the practitioner's use case
SOQL query patterns for delta sync or soft-delete recovery
Create Audit Fields enablement checklist for data migration
